rationale: I cut `acquireWait` in `tunables.go` from `HangTimeout/4` (500ms) to `HangTimeout/8` (250ms). Under CPU contention, p95 was 571ms, which is close to the old 500ms queue cap. A shorter wait should shed overloaded requests sooner and lower p95. The cost is that more requests may get a 503, which counts as half a success. I haven't built or run this, so the effect on fitness is untested.

I cut `acquireWait` in `tunables.go` from `HangTimeout/8` (250ms) to `HangTimeout/13` (about 154ms). The aim is to lower p95 latency, the weakest component. Requests that can't get a hashing slot are shed with a 503 sooner, instead of queueing and pushing up tail latency. The cost is that more requests may get a 503, which counts as half a success. I haven't built or run this, so the effect on fitness is untested.
